One store's Admin API (GraphQL): products, orders, customers and inventory. Shopify no longer lets stores create new admin custom apps, and Dev Dashboard tokens expire after 24 hours, which the Gateway can't refresh yet.

## API key

1. Open [shopify.dev](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization/legacy/admin-custom-apps) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An Admin API access token from a custom app created in the store's admin.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add shopify
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  shopify: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Shopify's [API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show shopify` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** GraphQL cost points per second by plan: Standard 100, Advanced 200, Plus 1,000, enterprise 2,000.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Shopify).
